_: One case per element whose visibility a hover affordance drives. `settings` holds only the OVERRIDES for the case — the manifest's own defaults are merged in first — and the window is `manifest.defaultSize`. `expect` is "hover-gated" (off screen, revealed by the host's `nt-hover` class, off screen again when it leaves) or "always-visible". `inert: true` also requires pointer-events to follow, so the hidden thing cannot be clicked. Opacity is measured up the whole ancestor chain — see README.md.
